flawless: My dead walk through any swamp and rise from any blow. You never stood a chance.
Not a bone of mine broken. My servants did all the work, as servants should.
solid: You put a few of my zombies down. They got back up. They always do.
The crypts are restless tonight, and you gave them good reason to be.
close: Every corpse I command is in pieces. You nearly emptied the Vess crypts.
I came close to joining my own legions. They would not have obeyed me then.
